stage: root-approved bounded native feasibility after22 passing pure tests; no full timing study
baseline: exposed_replication_2026-11-08 frozen exposed dolphin and dense global gannet planners
interpretation: Imposed one-way causal launch deferral, not a biological oscillator or calibrated communication law. Launch lag is not prey-region arrival lag.
native_feasibility_design: Disabled timing wrapper4T compared exactly to the already sealed4T baseline smoke; enabled lag1T8T compared to the predeclared first8T of the already sealed36T baseline. New execution totals12T. If no actual deferral occurs, report uninformative feasibility; do not tune lag or extend beyond budget.
cue: An actual committed dolphin launch; published after all actors finish the physical step, usable only in the next step. Store event-time interpolated body and target positions, target ID, actor ID, bout ID and time.
locality: At the original legal G plunge decision: distance from current G body to stored D launch body <=12 in3D; distance from current G target to stored D launch target <=4 in3D. Both are explicit imposed cue criteria. Fish may move after the cue; no future D event or hidden phase is supplied.
choice: Among qualifying recent cues select latest launch, then actor ID and bout ID. Bind once per G bout opportunity. Requested release is cue time+lag. If release has passed, launch normally.
loss_rule: A bound cue is never replaced during the same opportunity. Missing target, lost locality or expiry cancels the delay; the next otherwise legal ordinary plunge proceeds. Expiry does not grant an illegal launch.
physical_intervention: Intercept only an original legal G orient-to-plunge call. Returning the same orient state executes original air movement and bounded turning. No recovery clock, speed, target selection, bout duration, depth, capture probability, prey response or contact engine change.
transactionality: Every repeated provisional advance starts from committed timing memory. Keep only the final plan's decision history; commit only history through the resolved contact cutoff. Publish partner cues only from resolved actual transitions.
effort: Original opportunities may be deferred or lost; no extra attempts or backlog. Common elapsed horizon includes waiting. This feasibility stage does not isolate timing efficiency from altered realised effort; an uncoupled delay control is required for a later causal feeding-efficiency study.
logs: Cue publication, decision qualification/local distances/current target, bound cue, first eligible time, requested release, release/cancellation, actual launches and water entries with cue-relative lags; target-neighbour cohort IDs. Actual prey-region arrival is separate from water entry and must not be claimed from a launch lag.
acceptance: Pure disabled replay exactly matches baseline motion/events/private RNG; native original versus disabled run matches every retained frame, final state, capture/tie/target RNG and actual events. Enabled feasibility must show at least one legal actual deferred plunge, otherwise no full timing expansion.
units: Uncalibrated model lengths and T; not metres or seconds
source_isolation: No edits to shared scientific sources. Timing hooks exist in experiment-specific function clones and private dense-planner modules only.
